name: The Elder Scrolls Online: Feast of Shadows
storyline:
Black Gem Foundry: Atronachs summoned from far planes of Oblivion power a pulsing forge at the heart of Coldharbour. Help Dalenor the Summoner destroy Soulbinder Vykand's twisted fabrications before they make it to the hands of the Worm Cult.

Naj-Caldeesh: Talen-Lah and his band of necromancers run amok in the legendary lost xanmeer of Naj-Caldeesh. Stop them before their dark magic corrupts and destroys the ancient site.
summary: The second dungeon pack of 2025, Feast of Shadows, is coming to live servers soon. It brings with it two new dungeons, Naj-Caldeesh and Black Gem Foundry. For now, the forgotten ruin of Naj-Caldeesh remains a mystery—perhaps to be unveiled soon. Instead, journey into the depths of Molag Bal’s Oblivion realm of Coldharbour to witness the perils of the Black Gem Foundry dungeon. Learn how events have unfolded there, what deadly threats it holds, and the precious rewards to claim from it.
